posts.title: I'm building a European serverless hosting platform
posts.description: (Or at least I will try to build it) There is no hosting provider like AWS. Period. Their services are so advancement that European Hosters are faaaaar away from providing similar managed solutions. With the current advancements in politics, the need for such services increasing instead of decreasing.
